

Faustery is the process of [[ascension]] without maintaining a state of [[nobility]]. It contrasts with [[Apotheosis]] which is ascension while maintaining a state of [[nobility]].<ref name=":0">https://evolution.faith/the-paths-of-ascension/</ref>

Apotheosis creates [[kami]], and [[faustery]] creates [[oni|Archons]]<ref name=":0" />
